references.text: The Lord gave the enemies into Israel's hand, a recurring theme in Joshua's conquests
Israel's complete victory with no survivors left, the same expression is used
Sidon is mentioned as a border area, the same geographical reference
Sidon is mentioned as one of the peoples who were left in the land
The Lord hands over enemies into Israel's hand, the same theological pattern
Command not to let anyone survive, background for the expression about no survivors
Sidon and Misrephoth-maim are mentioned as areas that had not yet been conquered
Similar expressions about striking the enemy until none were left
